    StartersGame night charades popcornButtered popcorn drizzled with white chocolate and sea saltHow to make it100g popping corn1 tbsp vegetable oil30g butter, melted200g white chocolate1/2 tsp sea salt flakesPop the corn with the oil in a large lidded pot.Toss with the melted butter and spread on a lined tray.Melt the white chocolate and drizzle all over.Sprinkle with sea salt.Leave to set.Break into clusters.Olaf's honey roast carrots with fetaHoney and thyme roast baby carrots with whipped feta and yoghurtHow to make it500g baby carrots2 tbsp honey4 sprigs of thyme2 tbsp olive oil150g feta150g Greek yoghurtToss the carrots with the honey, thyme and oil.Roast at 200°C until sticky.Whip the feta with the yoghurt until smooth.Serve the carrots warm around the dip.Enchanted forest mushroom toastsThe enchanted forest in autumnHow to make itAs written, serves 4Mixed mushrooms seared hard in brown butter with garlic and thyme, piled onto charred sourdough with whipped ricotta and shaved parmesan.Mix 200g ricotta with the zest of 1 lemon and salt and whip until smooth.Melt 40g butter in a large pan until golden and nutty, add 400g torn mixed mushrooms and fry over high heat for 5 minutes until browned.Add 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and cook 1 minute.Grill 4 slices of sourdough until charred.Spread with ricotta, pile on the mushrooms and finish with shaved parmesan.Hot smoked salmon on ryeLieutenant Mattias's thirty four years of campfire cooking.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsArendelle fish stewSalmon, white fish and prawns simmered with leeks and potatoesHow to make it2 leeks, sliced30g butter400g potatoes, diced1 L water300g salmon fillet300g white fish fillets200g green prawns, peeled150ml thickened cream1/4 cup dill, chopped8 slices of rye breadSlice the leeks, dice the potatoes and cut the fish into chunks. Peel the prawns.Soften the leeks in the butter.Add the potatoes and water and simmer until tender.Add the salmon, white fish and prawns and cook until just done.Stir in the cream and dill and serve with rye bread.Northuldra juniper roast lambThe Northuldra camp in the forestHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb shoulder rubbed with juniper, garlic and rosemary, slow roasted until it falls apart, with charred root vegetables and lingonberry-style jam.Crush 1 tbsp juniper berries with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary leaves, olive oil and salt and rub over a 2kg lamb shoulder.Put in a roasting tin with 250ml water, cover with foil and roast at 150°C for 5 hours.Add 1kg chopped carrots, parsnips and beetroot for the last 90 minutes, uncovering for the final 30 minutes.Pull the lamb apart and serve with cranberry sauce.SweetsAhtohallan ice blue pavlovaCrisp meringue with whipped cream, blueberries and a dusting of icing sugarHow to make it4 eggs, whites only220g caster sugar300ml thickened cream250g blueberries2 tbsp icing sugarWhisk the egg whites to stiff peaks.Add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.Shape into a round on lined paper and bake at 120°C.Cool in the oven with the door closed.Whip the cream, top the pavlova with cream and blueberries and dust with icing sugar.DrinksKristoff's hot spiced apple punchWarm apple juice with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and maple syrupHow to make it1.5 L cloudy apple juice6 cinnamon sticks6 cloves1 orange2 tbsp maple syrupPeel strips of zest from the orange and slice the flesh.Warm the apple juice, 2 cinnamon sticks, cloves, zest and maple syrup over low heat without boiling.Strain into mugs and add a fresh cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each.Serve with carrots on the side for anyone who brought a reindeer.Cloudberry juiceGale the wind spirit brings it round.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
